input_contract: Implement a3x3 ordered binary-method table and one-entry cache. A cache is bound to one struct ds_methods object; its key includes ordered type pair and non-wrapping table epoch. Epoch1 is empty; each admitted registration/removal increments it and epoch3 forbids further changes. Add a two-entry cache and compare direct table lookup. Specify a separate subtype fallback graph and reject ambiguous equally specific matches instead of silently choosing registration order.
expected: Register subtraction for(0,1): arguments10,2 produce8; reversed types(1,0) are unsupported. Replace the same entry with addition: the old cached result must be invalidated and produce12. A third registration rejects at the finite epoch limit.
independent_oracle: Use an uncached dictionary keyed by ordered pair and version as the independent oracle. Replay every sequence of up to4 registrations/calls over types0–2 and methods add/subtract/missing, respecting finite epochs. Record cache hits/misses separately from correctness. Add a new table identity while retaining cache storage to demonstrate why ownership binding matters.
